findings.summary: The `!hasBoundedContext` fallback is incorrectly deferred because it is placed after the early returns for attempt 1 and 2, causing the first two attempts to execute with zero code context when bounded extraction fails.
findings.suggested_fix: Move the `if (!hasBoundedContext)` block above the `if (attempt === 1)` early return so that the full-diff fallback triggers immediately when no context can be extracted.
